results.detail: Set gen_name is (DT_WSTR,4)(DT_I4)gen_producttypeid + "-" + (DT_WSTR,12)(DT_I8)gen_bankaccountnumber, with errorRowDisposition and truncationRowDisposition = FailComponent (DTSX:34382+). It sits on the main path before the create/update split, so a conversion failure fails the whole data flow. The Success-only chain then stops all later steps; this is correct. The population is overstated. Set gen_name sees only rows of Get Funds Without Linked Customer Accounts. Those are funds with gen_existinfile = 1 that also inner-join product (productid = gen_fundtypename) and gen_customeraccounttype (gen_id = producttypeid AND gen_bankname = fund bank) (DTSX:33252). A fund flagged gen_existinfile = 1 that has no matching product or customer-account-type row is never read, and its non-numeric account number fails nothing. A non-numeric gen_producttypeid, or an account number longer than 12 digits (truncation → FailComponent), fails the flow in the same way.
